origins.section: Identical Crews Make Every Plan Appear Once per Numbering of the Crews
An Ordering Row Keeps at Least One Copy of Every Plan and Removes the Rest
Identical Jobs Are Symmetric Too: Count Them Instead of Naming Them

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-copies: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-copies: "With 4 crews there are 4! = 24 numberings, so a plan that uses all four crews with different jobs appears as 24 different points". With 3 trucks that is 3! = 6.
recorded.prompt:q-both-families: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-both-families: "Take a plan whose busiest crew does not hold job 0 ... that plan loses every copy. If it was the only optimal plan, the optimum changes."
recorded.prompt:q-counting: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-counting: "give the model a count, not a list of names"; "only counting does" make the model smaller (57 to 25 variables).

recorded.prompt:q-copies:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-copies:a: The count is the number of numberings, n!, which is 6 for three trucks, not 3.
recorded.prompt:q-copies:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-copies:b: The copies are renumberings (n!), not on/off switches.
recorded.prompt:q-copies:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-copies:c: "To the business these 24 points are one plan... To the MILP they are 24 different optimal solutions."
recorded.prompt:q-both-families:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-both-families:b: "Never both ... No numbering does both, so that plan loses every copy."

recorded.outcome:q-both-families:c: "Nor does the second family buy a smaller search for sure: removing copies is not a promise of fewer nodes".
